mureka/api/generate/lyrics-video.description: Creates a lyrics video from generated or uploaded audio, with selectable layouts, aspect ratios, backgrounds, and lyric-row or time-range selection.

lyrics_start_row.title: Lyrics Start Row
lyrics_start_row.description: First lyric row to include, starting at 1. Must be paired with lyrics_end_row and cannot be combined with a time selection. Provide either both lyric-row fields or both selection_start and selection_end. One complete pair is required.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional title displayed in the lyrics video.

upload_audio_id.title: Upload Audio Id
upload_audio_id.description: Audio ID returned by /files/upload with purpose='audio'. Provide exactly one of song_id or upload_audio_id.

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

cover_url.title: Cover Url
cover_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL or data URI for a JPG, PNG, or WebP cover. Not supported with layout_1.

selection_end.title: Selection End
selection_end.description: End of the included audio range in milliseconds. Must be paired with selection_start and cannot be combined with lyric-row selection. Provide either both time-selection fields or both lyrics_start_row and lyrics_end_row. One complete pair is required.

selection_start.title: Selection Start
selection_start.description: Start of the included audio range in milliseconds. Must be paired with selection_end and cannot be combined with lyric-row selection. Provide either both time-selection fields or both lyrics_start_row and lyrics_end_row. One complete pair is required.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Visual layout template for the lyrics video.

background_id.title: Background Id
background_id.description: Background image ID returned by /files/upload with purpose='lyrics-video'.

lyrics_end_row.title: Lyrics End Row
lyrics_end_row.description: Last lyric row to include. Must be paired with lyrics_start_row and cannot be combined with a time selection. Provide either both lyric-row fields or both selection_start and selection_end. One complete pair is required.

song_id.title: Song Id
song_id.description: Generated audio ID from song_id in a song or instrumental response. Provide exactly one of song_id or upload_audio_id.

frames_per_second.title: Frames per Second
frames_per_second.description: Frames per second of the generated video. Must be between 4 to 60. When using interpolation and `adjust_fps_for_interpolation` is set to true (default true,) the final FPS will be multiplied by the number of interpolated frames plus one. For example, if the generated frames per second is 16 and the number of interpolated frames is 1, the final frames per second will be 32. If `adjust_fps_for_interpolation` is set to false, this value will be used as-is.

video_write_mode.title: Video Write Mode
video_write_mode.description: The write mode of the output video. Faster write mode means faster results but larger file size, balanced write mode is a good compromise between speed and quality, and small write mode is the slowest but produces the smallest file size.

num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps for sampling. Higher values give better quality but take longer.
